title: The cut-open torus walk as two particles, its quarter-turn cone, and the return map of the cut line at powers of two
claim: For the walk A of the n x n torus of rule-60 rings cut open both ways, over GF(2), in doubled coordinates: (1) A = T_e (x) R + T_o (x) L = L (x) T_e + R (x) T_o on the contacts (Kronecker order (Y, X); T_e, T_o the swaps of a side's even and odd bonds, R, L the shifts); (2) the quarter turn acts freely and commutes with A, so det(xI - A) = det(xI - A_cone)^4 for the walk A_cone on its n(n - 1)/2 orbits, at every side; (3) at n = 2^m the uncut walk satisfies M^(2^j) = the sum of the four translations by 2^j for j >= 1, so (I - wM)^-1 = (I + wM) prod_(j=1)^(m-1) (I + w^(2^j) tau_(2^j)); (4) at n = 2^m, with G, H the cut-line blocks, B = G^-1 H = (I + w^2 K) H the first-passage matrix and C = BJ: det(I - wA) = det(I + C)^2 = det(I + C_s)^4 and det(I - w A_cone) = det(I + C_s(w)), C_s the (n/2) x (n/2) action of C on J-symmetric vectors. Computed exactly: the Smith form of I + C_s at 4, 8, 16 is the cone's Jordan data; at 4 to 64 every eigenvalue lambda of the cone is a (2n - 1)-th root of unity of multiplicity k(k + 1)/2 with Jordan blocks 2k - 1, 2k - 5, ..., odd exactly when Tr(1/lambda) = 1; tr(A_cone^j) = 1 exactly when j is a power of two mod 2n - 1; the cone polynomials of n and 2n agree below degree 2n and differ there; det(z + C_s) has e_1 = w + w^3, val e_j = j(2j - 1) and e_(n/2 - 1) = w^((h-1)(2h-3)) (sum_(i<m) w^(2^i - 1))^2. The collapse at every power of two is not proved.
failure_conditions: A side at which A differs from T_e (x) R + T_o (x) L or from L (x) T_e + R (x) T_o on the contacts.
A side at which the quarter turn has a fixed point or a point of period 2, fails to commute with A, or charpoly(A) != charpoly(A_cone)^4.
A power of two at which a cut-line block relation fails or det(I - w A_cone) != det(I + C_s).

A power of two to 64 at which an eigenvalue of the cone is not a (2n - 1)-th root of unity, a multiplicity is not triangular, the Jordan blocks are not 2k - 1, 2k - 5, ..., or the parity differs from Tr(1/lambda).

A power of two at which the Smith form of I + C_s differs from the cone's Jordan data, the cone polynomials of n and 2n first differ below degree 2n, or the return map's characteristic polynomial breaks the stated form.
foundation_claim_scope: The square torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12, 12) contacts, cut open by a ring of cuts each way (A30, A32, A37, A38); its walk over GF(2). Theorems 1 to 4 are proved; the Smith form, the Jordan and parity laws, the stability and the return map's characteristic polynomial are computed at sides 4 to 64; the collapse at every power of two is open.

validation.status: proof by hand (Theorems 1 to 4) with finite checks; the laws computed exactly to side 64; the stress run at 128: stage 1 passed (the collapse at 128, the traces, stability and the return map's laws), stage 2 (multiplicities and Jordan blocks) pending at closure
validation.novelty: new as far as found for this walk; no literature search beyond the ingredients (Schur complements, modules over GF(2)[Z/4], Lucas' theorem, Clebsch-Gordan for sl2)
